_comment: Single source of truth for known data absences across the SKY Piano corpus. Loaded by pipeline._common.known_absences. Each entry describes data that is permanently missing from the raw capture (camera off, marker dislodge, sensor failure, etc.) and SHOULD NOT be treated as a pipeline failure or release-time gap. Schema: each entry has a unique id, a kind (defines which selector keys apply), a scope, selectors (what trials/views/markers are affected), a reason, and provenance.

_kinds.video_view: A camera view (Top|Left|Right|RightLow) is missing for a set of trials. Selector: trial_stems[], views[].
_kinds.body_data: Entire body-motion stream is missing for a trial (raw TSV not captured / unrecoverable). Selector: trial_stems[].
_kinds.hand_marker: One or more hand-motion markers/columns are missing in raw capture. Selector: trial_stems[] OR (cohort + pool_id + task), markers[]. May still be downstream-recoverable (offset model, anchor-median injection); 'recovered_in' notes that.
_kinds.marker_restored: Markers/columns were missing in raw capture but are reconstructed by Stage 02 hand s02_restore_markers via an offset model from a sibling-marker pair. Selector: trial_stems[], filenames[] (csv basenames as referenced by markers.py DATASET_CONFIGS), missing_cols[]. recovery.method/target_cols/input_cols feeds the restore step.
_kinds.trial_skip: An entire trial is excluded from a stage. Selector: trial_stems[], stages[].
_kinds.audio_midi: A take's audio and MIDI are not in the session recording (the recorder was paused or stopped during it); the trial keeps its motion only. Selector: trial_stems[].

absences.reason: Left-deck camera was not recording during sub08 Set1 second-half pieces (P4-P8). Raw video files for these SMPTE ranges do not exist in Raw/240828/C0/N8/Video/Left/.
absences.discovered_by: Stage 04 s05_slice_piece_videos.py NO-match log on Set1 40-take slice run

absences.reason: Body Qualisys TSV not captured for sub0636 (raw stem). Unrecoverable - 3 piece-csvs absent in Stage 04 body output. Stage 07 body imputation cannot recover an entirely missing trial.
absences.discovered_by: Stage 02 body_aligned audit (352/355 body-csv after REnd offset restore)

absences.reason: Glissando passages caused mocap markers to fall off mid-take. Curator removed all right-hand markers and left-hand End markers from that point on. Audio + MIDI intact; only motion is partially marker-stripped. The End-offset reconstruction trick (used in feedback_rend_lend_regression) does NOT recover RH because RH is fully stripped - downstream RH analysis should be marked 'not applicable' rather than imputed.

Raw OptiTrack capture for P8/P9 used a different marker set - hand CSVs lack Lsh/Rsh/Lelbow/Relbow columns (P8 only LLAW/RLAW wrist; P9 only Lwrist). Recovered downstream by anchor-median injection (session-median across P1-P7) into temp copies; geometric residuals elevated (P8 mean 85mm/max 157mm, P9 mean 76mm/max 111mm).
absences.recovered_in: a separate anchor-hand rebuild outside the pipeline (Stage 02 hand Aligned CSVs intentionally retain NaN)
absences.discovered_by: Stage 02 body alignment for newly-added 240523 body integration

absences.reason: LEnd not recorded in mocap capture for this trial. LEnd reconstructed from REnd via median offset learned across complete trials (piano-stationary so offset is near-constant per setup).

REnd not recorded in mocap capture for these 3 trials. REnd reconstructed from LEnd via median offset learned across complete trials (piano-stationary so offset is near-constant per setup). filenames carries both canonical trial_stem and raw sub-numbered stem because Stage 02 hand copies pre-canonical files in some cases.

The body take of this trial (raw 2022Piano02_02_02_01.tsv) holds about 2 s of data. Without this entry the Stage 01 matcher pairs the trial with 2022Piano02_02_02_02.tsv, the body take of the next hand take (no audio/MIDI exported); registered onto this trial's hand frame that file leaves a 70 mm mean landmark residual (3.8-14 mm for the session's other trials).

Hand take Piano02_08_01_04 (363 s) does not fit the session recording: by the capture start frames it lies between takes t3 and t5, whose recording positions leave 317 s, so the recorder was paused during it; no position matches its key presses, and the reviewer rejected the best one by eye.
absences.discovered_by: 221112 placement review (Stage 01 s04, Stage 05 sync check)
